analysis.title: FY25 H2 EMEA Business Review
analysis.key_message: This is a business review presentation covering the second half of fiscal year 2025 for the EMEA region, presented in December 2025.

analysis.title: Meet The Team
analysis.key_message: Introduction to the Media & Entertainment account team, featuring leadership from sales, analytics, operations, and account management roles.
insights: Team includes senior leadership (VP and Managing Director level) showing executive commitment
Cross-functional team structure with representation from Sales, Analytics, Operations, and Account Management
Dedicated Media & Entertainment vertical focus with specialized team members

analysis.title: Today's Agenda
analysis.key_message: This QBR presentation will cover six main areas: partnership highlights, latest updates, D+ app profile, FY25 H2 performance results, high impact spotlight, and forward-looking recommendations.
insights: The presentation follows a standard QBR structure moving from retrospective (partnership highlights, performance) to prospective (recommendations and looking ahead)
Focus on D+ (likely Disney+) app performance in fiscal year 2025 second half
Includes a 'High Impact Spotlight' section suggesting emphasis on key achievements or initiatives
action_items: Follow the agenda structure through the remaining slides
Pay attention to FY25 H2 performance metrics in section 04
Review recommendations in section 06 for next steps

analysis.title: FY25 Year at a Glance - Disney XLOB Partnership Performance
analysis.key_message: FY25 delivered exceptional growth with $34M total investment (77% YoY increase from $17M), driven primarily by Disney+ Global's $18M contribution (2x FY24), with strategic expansion across 24 markets and H2 acceleration generating over $500K in added value.

metrics.name: Total XLOB Investment
metrics.context: FY25 total across 20 Lines of Business

metrics.name: EMEA Share of Global
metrics.context: EMEA as percentage of Disney+ Global

metrics.name: Added Value
metrics.context: Total added value delivered in FY25

metrics.name: Market Coverage
metrics.context: Live paid media markets (up from 21 in FY24)

metrics.name: USA Domestic Added Value
metrics.context: Domestic value delivered back to business

insights: Disney+ Global was the primary growth driver, contributing 52% of total XLOB investment and doubling FY24 performance
Second-half acceleration was significant, with EMEA contributing $3.168M in H2 alone (nearly 60% of their annual total)
Market expansion from 21 to 24 markets demonstrates geographic scaling strategy
Strategic shift from 96% static creative to more dynamic formats including video/interactivity carousel
Structured testing program across multiple variables (Price vs. No Price, Asset Mix, Tune-In vs. Evergreen) established foundation for FY26 optimization
100% Bundle Duo/Trio support and EDTC/Unlimited Bundle launch were key strategic priorities
Two-thirds of USA Disney+ investment ($8.5M total) came in H2, showing strong partnership momentum and scalability
action_items: Leverage FY25 test learnings (Price vs. No Price, Asset Mix, Tune-In vs. Evergreen, Promo creative) for FY26 planning
Continue H2 momentum and scaling strategies into FY26
Expand on suppression tactics and video/interactivity carousel creative approaches
Build on Bundle Duo/Trio success and promotional campaign learnings

analysis.title: But First…
analysis.key_message: This slide introduces the upcoming strategic topics for discussion, including the LG Ads x Disney FY26 partnership, retention planning, sports on Disney+, market expansions, and CTV video product expansion.
insights: The presentation will cover cross-line-of-business (XLOB) partnership strategies between LG Ads and Disney for FY26
Sports content on Disney+ is a key strategic focus area
Geographic expansion into MENA (Middle East and North Africa) and other markets is planned
Product expansion into CTV (Connected TV) video advertising is a priority initiative
action_items: Review retention planning strategies
Evaluate market expansion opportunities in MENA and other regions
Assess CTV video product expansion roadmap

analysis.title: Product Innovation: Content Notifications Beta
analysis.key_message: Disney+ is launching Content Notifications Beta on LG Smart TVs in Australia (December) and US (December-March) to reach users in real-time when they turn on their TV, driving immediate engagement with featured content like Taylor Swift's Eras Tour and Percy Jackson.

metrics.name: Pop-up Display Duration
metrics.context: Initial notification visibility on TV power-on

metrics.name: Notification Flight Window
metrics.context: Duration notification remains accessible in Notification Center

insights: Content Notifications enable Disney+ to capture user attention at the moment of TV power-on, converting passive device usage into active app engagement
Two-tier notification system: immediate 5-second pop-up for awareness, plus persistent 7-day panel notification for deeper engagement
Beta strategy targets high-value content (Taylor Swift Eras Tour, Percy Jackson, Pole 2 Pole) to test feature effectiveness
Australia serves as initial test market in December before broader US rollout through March
Feature is deeplinkable, allowing direct navigation from notification to content, reducing friction in user journey
action_items: Monitor beta performance in Australia (December) with Taylor Swift Eras Tour content
Prepare US domestic rollout for December-March with aligned content (Percy Jackson, Pole 2 Pole, Paradise S2, ABC Show TBC)
Collect user feedback during beta to improve notification effectiveness
Track conversion metrics from notification view to content engagement

App rankings are consistently strong across EU5 markets (#4-5 positions)
Average reach across EU5 is approximately 30%, indicating significant room for growth
70% of active LG TVs remain untapped, representing a major growth opportunity
Spain shows second-highest engagement with 8M streaming hours despite lower reach than UK
action_items: Develop paid media strategy to increase Disney+ app adoption on LG TVs
Target the 70% of untapped active LG TV users across EU5 markets
Prioritize UK market given its leading performance metrics
Consider market-specific strategies given varying reach percentages (26-34%)

analysis.title: EMEA Disney+ Active User Growth
analysis.key_message: Turkey leads EMEA Disney+ growth at +27% (460K MAUs), with strong double-digit gains across Southern Europe (Spain +10%, Italy +10%), indicating broad regional momentum from April to September 2025.

metrics.name: Turkey Non-Installation Rate

metrics.context: Of installed Disney+ users in Turkey

insights: Turkey demonstrates the highest growth rate in EMEA at +27%, significantly outpacing other markets
Southern European markets (Spain, Italy) show strong double-digit growth at +10%, indicating regional momentum
Turkey represents a major opportunity market with 30% of LG TVs lacking Disney+ installation and 70% of installed users being lapsed
Turkey's marketing efficiency improved significantly from H1 to H2, with CPPC decreasing from $14.89 to $11.03 despite increased investment
Investment in Turkey increased 44% from H1 ($269K) to H2 ($388K), correlating with improved efficiency metrics
Heavy focus on Turkish Originals versus Global titles may be influencing performance and presents content strategy optimization opportunity
action_items: Capitalize on Turkey's growth momentum by targeting the 30% non-installed LG TV base
Develop win-back campaigns for the 70% lapsed user segment in Turkey
Rebalance Turkey's content promotion strategy to include more Global launches alongside Turkish Originals
Replicate Turkey's efficiency improvements (26% CPPC reduction) in other high-growth markets
Investigate drivers of double-digit growth in Spain and Italy to scale best practices across EU5

analysis.title: Disney+ App on LG TVs: EU5 Performance
analysis.key_message: Disney+ demonstrates strong growth on LG TVs across five major European markets, with MAU growing from 549K to 2.0M, reaching up to 34% of active LG TVs, and maintaining a #4 app ranking position.
insights: Disney+ MAU grew 264% from 549K to 2.0M across the measurement period
LG platform MAU increased 181% from 2.1M to 5.9M, indicating overall platform growth
Disney+ reach of active LG TVs improved from 26% to 34%, showing market penetration gains
App ranking improved from #5 to #4 and stabilized, demonstrating competitive positioning
Data covers five major European markets: UK, Spain, Germany, Italy, and France
action_items: Analyze individual market performance to identify best practices from top-performing countries
Investigate opportunities to improve app ranking from #4 to top 3 position
Leverage the 34% reach achievement as a benchmark for other markets

analysis.title: Disney+ App User Profile on LG TVs
analysis.key_message: 67% of LG TVs with Disney+ installed in EMEA are lapsed users (up 1ppt from last half), representing a significant re-engagement opportunity, while overall app installation reached 76% (up 2ppt).

metrics.name: Lapsed Users
metrics.context: Of TVs with Disney+ installed in EMEA

insights: 67% of Disney+ installed base on LG TVs in EMEA are lapsed users, indicating significant churn or dormancy
Installation rate increased 2 percentage points to 76%, showing positive growth in app adoption
Lapsed user percentage increased by 1 percentage point, suggesting engagement challenges despite growing install base
Only 33% of users with the app installed are active (used within last 60 days), highlighting retention opportunity
Q4 tactical shift focused on suppressing only heavy active users and reducing untargeted roadblocks
action_items: Target the 67% lapsed user segment with re-engagement campaigns to drive subscriptions
Continue ROS (Run of Site) tactics with selective suppression of heavy active users
Optimize roadblock strategy to balance reach with targeted efficiency
Develop campaigns specifically for tentpole content to drive high reach among lapsed users

executive_summary.summary: Disney+ achieved exceptional performance on LG TV advertising during FY25 H2 (April-September 2025), delivering 1.6M proxy conversions from a $2.8M investment across EMEA markets. The campaign generated 308M impressions, 21M app launches, and reached 17M unique users at a cost per proxy conversion of $1.79. Performance improved dramatically versus H1, with launches up 78%, proxy conversions up 61%, reach up 18%, and cost per engagement down 32%. These gains were driven by strategic shifts toward video-enhanced carousel formats (increasing from 4% to 36% of creative mix), expanded suppression-based audience targeting, and increased investment in high-impact Home Screen Roadblocks. Despite strong performance, significant growth opportunity remains as Disney+ reaches only ~30% of active LG TVs across EU5 markets, with 67% of installed users classified as lapsed, presenting a clear path for continued acquisition and reactivation efforts.
key_wins: Delivered 1.6M proxy conversions at $1.79 CPE, representing 61% increase versus H1 with 32% lower cost per engagement
Generated 21M app launches (78% increase vs H1) and reached 17.3M unique users (18% increase) from $2.8M investment
Home Screen Roadblocks delivered outsized impact, representing only 15% of spend but driving 28% of total reach with 3x better cost per proxy conversion efficiency
Content Store Roadblocks achieved 2-4x higher CTR and launch rates versus benchmarks, successfully expanding from UK/DE to include France and Italy in Q4
Strategic creative evolution from 96% static assets in H1 to 64% in H2, with Carousel Video Companion delivering 59% higher CTR and 103% higher launch rates versus static formats
areas_for_improvement: Disney+ app penetration remains at only ~30% of active LG TVs across EU5 markets, leaving approximately 70% of devices untapped for acquisition
67% of users with Disney+ installed are classified as lapsed (inactive for 60+ days), indicating significant reactivation opportunity
Lapsed ROS targeting not yet expanded to all EMEA markets, with opportunities in Romania, Czech Republic, Finland, and Denmark
Static carousel creative still represents 64% of assets despite video formats showing significantly stronger performance across all KPIs
recommendations: Expand lapsed user targeting to all EMEA markets including Romania, Czech Republic, Finland, and Denmark to maximize reactivation opportunities across the 67% lapsed user base
Increase investment in Carousel Video Companion formats given 59% higher CTR, 103% higher launch rates, and 2.5x proxy conversions versus static creative
Scale Home Screen Roadblock investment on key tentpole dates across EMEA, as this placement delivers 3x cost per proxy conversion efficiency while driving 28%+ reach with only 15% of budget
Prioritize Content Store Roadblock bookings across all available markets (currently France, Italy, Spain) given consistent 2-4x performance versus benchmarks and strong acquisition results
next_steps: Implement suppression-based audience targeting across expanded EMEA markets to replicate the 58% CTR improvement and 63% cost per proxy conversion gains achieved in tested markets
Transition creative mix to minimum 50% video-enhanced formats (Carousel Companion and 3D Animated) for FY26 campaigns based on H2 performance data
Secure Content Store Roadblock inventory for FY26 tentpole moments across UK, DE, FR, IT, and ES with 2-week fixed flights aligned to major content launches
Leverage new Global Dashboard capabilities including custom date ranges, MAU data by market, and Acquired/Engaged User metrics for enhanced campaign planning and optimization
Pilot Content Notifications beta in Australia (December) and US (December-March) to test real-time user engagement at TV power-on moments
